description: This file defines a Go package 'flag' that implements a custom flag type 'ColonSeparatedMultimapStringString' for parsing command-line flags into a map[string][]string, supporting colon-separated key-value pairs and multiple entries per key.

classes.name: ColonSeparatedMultimapStringString
classes.description: A struct supporting parsing and formatting of colon-separated key-value pairs into a map[string][]string, with options for default empty keys and initialization control.

methods.name: NewColonSeparatedMultimapStringString
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the struct with a pointer to a map[string][]string.

methods.name: NewColonSeparatedMultimapStringStringAllowDefaultEmptyKey
methods.description: Constructor that allows default empty keys with no colon in the flag.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of colon-separated key-value pairs and appends them to the map.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the map in colon-separated key-value pairs, sorted by key.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type name for flag parsing.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.
